changeSet.comment: Add two beds to every physical room under an admission location
changeSet.sql:
INSERT INTO bed (bed_number, status, bed_type_id, uuid, creator, date_created, voided) SELECT CONCAT( CASE room.uuid WHEN '9212680d-bb7c-412a-bd07-d24358f5a4ad' THEN 'URG' WHEN '046a84ac-cd6a-4725-b712-24cb115d1c55' THEN 'GEN-H1' WHEN '6f9ad5d9-bcfe-45fb-82b1-c48bf6ae051f' THEN 'GEN-H2' WHEN 'df352801-7c6c-4dd5-bbef-0c01a216d453' THEN 'PED-H1' ELSE CONCAT('SALA-', LEFT(room.uuid, 8)) END, '-', slot.suffix ) AS bed_number, 'AVAILABLE' AS status, NULL AS bed_type_id, UUID() AS uuid, 1 AS creator, NOW() AS date_created, FALSE AS voided FROM location room JOIN location ward ON ward.location_id = room.parent_location AND ward.retired = FALSE JOIN location_tag_map room_tag_map ON room_tag_map.location_id = room.location_id JOIN location_tag room_tag ON room_tag.location_tag_id = room_tag_map.location_tag_id AND room_tag.name = 'Admission Location' JOIN location_tag_map ward_tag_map ON ward_tag_map.location_id = ward.location_id JOIN location_tag ward_tag ON ward_tag.location_tag_id = ward_tag_map.location_tag_id AND ward_tag.name = 'Admission Location' JOIN ( SELECT '01' AS suffix, 1 AS bed_row_number, 1 AS bed_column_number UNION ALL SELECT '02' AS suffix, 1 AS bed_row_number, 2 AS bed_column_number ) slot ON 1 = 1 WHERE room.retired = FALSE AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM bed_location_map occupied_position WHERE occupied_position.location_id = room.location_id AND occupied_position.bed_row_number = slot.bed_row_number AND occupied_position.bed_column_number = slot.bed_column_number AND occupied_position.bed_id IS NOT NULL ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM bed existing_bed WHERE existing_bed.bed_number = CONCAT( CASE room.uuid WHEN '9212680d-bb7c-412a-bd07-d24358f5a4ad' THEN 'URG' WHEN '046a84ac-cd6a-4725-b712-24cb115d1c55' THEN 'GEN-H1' WHEN '6f9ad5d9-bcfe-45fb-82b1-c48bf6ae051f' THEN 'GEN-H2' WHEN 'df352801-7c6c-4dd5-bbef-0c01a216d453' THEN 'PED-H1' ELSE CONCAT('SALA-', LEFT(room.uuid, 8)) END, '-', slot.suffix ) AND existing_bed.voided = FALSE );
INSERT INTO bed_location_map (location_id, bed_row_number, bed_column_number, bed_id) SELECT room.location_id, slot.bed_row_number, slot.bed_column_number, bed.bed_id FROM location room JOIN location ward ON ward.location_id = room.parent_location AND ward.retired = FALSE JOIN location_tag_map room_tag_map ON room_tag_map.location_id = room.location_id JOIN location_tag room_tag ON room_tag.location_tag_id = room_tag_map.location_tag_id AND room_tag.name = 'Admission Location' JOIN location_tag_map ward_tag_map ON ward_tag_map.location_id = ward.location_id JOIN location_tag ward_tag ON ward_tag.location_tag_id = ward_tag_map.location_tag_id AND ward_tag.name = 'Admission Location' JOIN ( SELECT '01' AS suffix, 1 AS bed_row_number, 1 AS bed_column_number UNION ALL SELECT '02' AS suffix, 1 AS bed_row_number, 2 AS bed_column_number ) slot ON 1 = 1 JOIN bed ON bed.bed_number = CONCAT( CASE room.uuid WHEN '9212680d-bb7c-412a-bd07-d24358f5a4ad' THEN 'URG' WHEN '046a84ac-cd6a-4725-b712-24cb115d1c55' THEN 'GEN-H1' WHEN '6f9ad5d9-bcfe-45fb-82b1-c48bf6ae051f' THEN 'GEN-H2' WHEN 'df352801-7c6c-4dd5-bbef-0c01a216d453' THEN 'PED-H1' ELSE CONCAT('SALA-', LEFT(room.uuid, 8)) END, '-', slot.suffix ) AND bed.voided = FALSE WHERE room.retired = FALSE AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM bed_location_map existing_mapping WHERE existing_mapping.location_id = room.location_id AND existing_mapping.bed_id = bed.bed_id );
